in_sanskrit.name: Ansaan
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Answer, solution
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ansaan एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Ansaan is a Sanskrit name derived from the root 'ans' meaning 'answer' or 'solution'. This name is given to a child who is expected to bring peace, clarity, and resolution to the family or society.
